$comment: Hand-written stand-in for `prism --help --json`. Replaced, not edited, once the CLI emits its own description. Verbs and flags follow the agreed v1.0 verb list.

globalFlags.meaning: Print the result as one JSON object instead of text.
Enable one experimental feature by name for this invocation.
Print usage for the verb and exit 0.

exitCodes.name: pass
exitCodes.meaning: The verb did what you asked and every check it ran passed.

exitCodes.name: fail
exitCodes.meaning: A check failed, an intent sentence is unproved, or a replay diverged.

exitCodes.name: cannot verify
exitCodes.meaning: No verdict was reached: a missing attestation, an unreachable registry or an unknown format revision.

verbs.name: init
verbs.summary: Scaffold a new application: `prism.toml`, `examples/`, `intent.md`, a default capability set and the lockfile.

flags.meaning: Which type source the scaffold writes.
Starting examples and intent.
Overwrite files that already exist.

verbs.name: build
verbs.summary: Compile the model into a holo inside the pinned toolchain image, record provenance and the proof attestation, and cache the result by spec digest.

flags.meaning: How much the provenance records. `max` adds every resolved input and the full toolchain environment.
Skip provenance. Unsafe: the holo cannot pass `check` above P0.
Rebuild even when the spec digest is unchanged.
Apply the matching overlay, `prism.browser.toml` or `prism.node.toml`.
How many times the agent may revise the model before the build fails.

verbs.name: check
verbs.summary: Verify the holo's digest, provenance, proof, lockfile pins and declared world against a policy, then print a verdict with the assurance level and reasons.

flags.meaning: Policy to judge against.
Do not contact the transparency log or any registry. Missing data exits 2.

verbs.name: run
verbs.summary: Instantiate the holo after `check` passes at the policy's level, then grant exactly the capability set it declares.

flags.meaning: One input to dispatch. Omit it to read inputs line by line.
Policy the gate judges against.
Run even when `check` fails. Prints a warning on every start.
Serve the instance over HTTP instead of dispatching once.

verbs.name: dev
verbs.summary: Watch the model, rebuild and re-check on every change, and serve a local studio with Check and Replay tabs.

flags.meaning: Studio port.
Do not open the studio in a browser.
Policy the Check tab judges against.

verbs.name: replay
verbs.summary: Re-execute a recorded history against the current build and fail on the first divergence.

flags.meaning: Which holo to replay against.
Continue past the first divergence and report every one.

verbs.name: push
verbs.summary: Push a holo and its attestations to an OCI registry. The attestations travel as referrers of the holo.

flags.meaning: Push to a local directory store instead of a registry.
Push the holo only. The pushed holo checks at P0.

verbs.name: pull
verbs.summary: Pull a holo and its attestations from an OCI registry or a local directory store.

flags.meaning: Pull from a local directory store.
Run `check` on the pulled holo and exit with its code.

verbs.name: deploy
verbs.summary: Publish the holo to a GitHub repository and GitHub Pages, serving its attestations alongside it.

flags.meaning: Repository to publish to.
Branch GitHub Pages serves.
Push the repository only.

verbs.name: export
verbs.summary: Write the six-file browser export, a tarball, or a runnable OCI image that `docker run` serves.

flags.meaning: Where the browser export is written.
Write one tarball instead of a directory.
Write a runnable OCI image under this name.

verbs.name: inspect
verbs.summary: Print the manifest, section digests, format revision, world and attestations of a holo without running it.

flags.meaning: Print one part only.
Print the security view: signers, trusted base, capability set, theorem list.
With `--audit`, write the report to a file.

verbs.name: attest
verbs.summary: Add a signed statement to a holo. Signing is keyless by default.

flags.meaning: JSON file holding the predicate.
Predicate type URI.
Sign with a local key for air-gapped use instead of keyless.

verbs.name: verify
verbs.summary: Check a signed statement on a holo against the signing identity you expect.

flags.meaning: Identity the statement must be signed by.
Issuer that identity must come from.
Verify statements of one predicate type only.
Verify against a local public key instead of keyless.

verbs.name: generate
verbs.summary: Regenerate the JS, Rust and Python bindings and the typed client from the world. Nothing is written when nothing changed.

flags.meaning: Output path.
Which bindings to write.

verbs.name: lock
verbs.summary: Write or refresh the lockfile from the current model and inputs, without building. Pins that still resolve stay as they are, and the toolchain image and toolchain pins do not move. Exits 2 when there is no lockfile or its SDK cannot be resolved.

flags.meaning: Write nothing. Fail when the lockfile is stale and name the pins that differ.

verbs.name: update
verbs.summary: Move the lockfile forward and print the old and new digests of every pin that changed. Without a flag it refreshes the toolchain pins; with `--toolchain` it also pins a new toolchain image. Exits 2 when the lockfile or the image cannot be resolved.

flags.meaning: Toolchain image to pin, as `name@sha256:digest`.
Standards lock the new image selects. Needs `--toolchain`.
Print the change without writing the lockfile.
